places.ai_summary: A vibrant market offering a wide range of textiles, handicrafts, and traditional goods made by local artisans.

opening_hours.notes: Saturday is the busiest and most vibrant day.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to avoid crowds and get the best deals on unique items.
